$description: Lifted without a contour: the surfaces and the controls have no border and rest on the page by blurred shadows in the tone of a dark paper (`color.shade`: that of `frost`, the foreground with another palette), in heights (the controls, the cards, the menus and the dialogs); the fields are a bottom line, not a lifted box; the primary button with a shadow of its own color, the current link of the sidebar lifted, and one focus ring; black shadows in the dark mode, where the paper is darker than any shade.

xs.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 8%, transparent)

lift-05.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 6%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 9%, transparent)

lift-05-hover.$value: 0 2px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 6%, transparent), 0 6px 14px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 14%, transparent)

lift-1.$value: 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 4%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 5%, transparent), 0 12px 28px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 14%, transparent)

lift-2.$value: 0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 5%, transparent), 0 10px 20px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 12%, transparent), 0 28px 48px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--shade) 20%, transparent)

lift-primary.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 30%, transparent), 0 3px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 28%, transparent)

lift-primary-hover.$value: 0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 28%, transparent), 0 8px 18px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 34%, transparent)
